# local-llm-mcp

Production-grade FastMCP 3.4.4+ server for local/cloud LLMs. 12 portmanteau tools, 28 gateway providers, SOTA web dashboard.

> Full reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Key Capabilities
- **12 portmanteau tools**: health, models, generation, multimodal, finetuning, ollama, lmstudio, vllm, huggingface, google_cloud, gpu, help
- **AI Gateway**: OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` routing to 28 providers
- **Provider Health Service**: Circuit breaker, 60s cache, LM Link probes
- **Web dashboard**: React 19 / Vite 6 on 10832, FastAPI backend on 10833
- **LM Link**: Tailscale-powered remote LLM access via `llm_lmstudio(operation="link_status")`
- **Session context injection**: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, OpenCode

## Quick Start
```powershell
just bootstrap && just serve
```

## Ports
| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 10832 | Dashboard frontend |
| 10833 | API + MCP HTTP + Gateway |
| 11434 | Ollama |
| 1234 | LM Studio |

## Core Tool Invocations
- `llm_health(operation="provider_check")` — probe all providers
- `llm_models(operation="list_models")` — discover models
- `llm_lmstudio(operation="link_status")` — LM Link remote peers
- `llm_generation(operation="generate_text", model="...", prompt="...")` — generate text
- `llm_health(operation="shutdown", confirm=True)` — graceful shutdown
